parsed.name: 内存项目存储系统
parsed.description: 用于实验软件中临时保存项目与数据项信息的内存存储组件，可存放数据项属性、关联关系及相关数据，常用于测试、会话期间缓存或不写入磁盘的项目管理。
parsed.description_en: An in-memory storage component for temporarily holding project and data-item information in laboratory software. It stores data-item properties, relationships, and associated data, and is typically used for testing, session caching, or project management without writing to disk.

actions.description: 记录已创建新的数据项
actions.description_en: Record that a new data item has been created.
